scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: Yes, I can help with that. Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Can you tell me what my interest rate and the total costs of the loan are? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 7.000%. The total costs of the loan are not present in the record. You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: I see. Thank you for that information. Can you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? Additionally, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features. Your loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Got it. Lastly, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it affect my application? Also, can you confirm the loan term and amount?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is not present in the record. The loan term is 60 months and the loan amount is $7,005,000.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I appreciate your help.

<Neutral> - The agent provided the necessary details about my loan, but I was hoping to get more information about my debt-to-income ratio, which wasn't available. Overall, the interaction was satisfactory, but I would have liked more clarity on that aspect.
